pool.text: Portuguese Pero Coelho de Souza constructed the Fort of Sao Tiago
Martins Soares Moreno expanded the fort and changed its name
Dutch forces invaded the Brazilian Northeast region
The fort was destroyed during battles with Portuguese and natives
Fort Schoonenborch officially opened on August 19th
The city was officially founded as a village
The city became the capital of Ceara state
The customs building of Fortaleza was built
Revolutionaries of the Confederation of the Equator targeted the city
The first hospital built was Santa Casa de Misericordia
The Ceara Institute was founded
The first university was created as Universidade Federal do Ceara
A cultural venue opened housing art collections and ruins
The city began integrating territory of Maracanau
The Integrated Transportation System bus operation began
The city became part of the Mercosur cities market
Pedra da Risca do Meio Marine State Park was created
An environmental protection area was set up at Rio Ceara
Former mayor Roberto Claudio won votes in the local election
The Fortaleza Metro started operation on October first
